decision.explanation: The original sources explicitly mention two distinct works titled 'David with the Head of Goliath'—one attributed to Caravaggio (D1S1, D2S12) and another to Massimo Stanzione (D5S1, D7S1). Both are valid referents for the same title, and neither source indicates that these are the same work. Leonardo da Vinci and Ribera are either incorrect (da Vinci) or incidental (Ribera, as a prior misattribution) and are not supported as primary artists of the work in question.
